name: Aryabhata
meaning_en: Noble warrior; the 5th-century mathematician and astronomer.

name: Bankim
meaning_en: Curved, gracefully bent (an epithet of Krishna); the novelist Bankim Chandra.

name: Bhartrihari
meaning_en: Name of the poet-philosopher of the Shatakatraya.

name: Bhavabhuti
meaning_en: Prosperity of Shiva; the Sanskrit dramatist.

name: Chanakya
meaning_en: Name of the strategist-minister of Chandragupta Maurya, author of the Arthashastra.

name: Chandragupta
meaning_en: Protected by the moon; founder of the Maurya empire, also two Gupta emperors.

name: Kalidas
meaning_en: Servant of Kali; the greatest classical Sanskrit poet.

name: Kanakadasa
meaning_en: Golden servant; the Kannada saint-poet devoted to Krishna.

name: Krishnadevaraya
meaning_en: Name of the great Vijayanagara emperor; Krishna as divine king.

name: Madanmohan
meaning_en: One who enchants even Kamadeva; Krishna.

name: Mohandas
meaning_en: Servant of Mohan (Krishna); Mahatma Gandhi's given name.

name: Namdev
meaning_en: God of the divine name; the Marathi saint-poet.

name: Panini
meaning_en: Name of the great Sanskrit grammarian.

name: Patanjali
meaning_en: Name of the sage who compiled the Yoga Sutras.

name: Prithviraj
meaning_en: King of the earth; the Chauhan king of Delhi and Ajmer.

name: Pulakeshi
meaning_en: Name of the great Chalukya king of Badami.

name: Rajguru
meaning_en: Royal preceptor.

name: Ramprasad
meaning_en: Grace of Rama.

name: Sambhaji
meaning_en: Named after Shambhu (Shiva); the second Maratha ruler.

name: Samudragupta
meaning_en: Protected by the ocean; the great Gupta emperor.

name: Shivaji
meaning_en: Named after the goddess Shivai; founder of the Maratha kingdom.

name: Sukhdev
meaning_en: God of happiness.

name: Sushruta
meaning_en: Well heard, renowned; the ancient surgeon of Ayurveda.

name: Tilak
meaning_en: The sacred mark on the forehead; ornament; also Lokmanya Tilak.

name: Tyagaraja
meaning_en: King of renunciation; the great Carnatic composer, named after Shiva of Tiruvarur.

name: Vivekananda
meaning_en: Bliss of discernment; the monk Swami Vivekananda.
